PHY_SFO_CONST 0x83086010 [27:16]/[11:0] = round(0x190000 / f_MHz), halved for '10 MHz' and quartered for '5 MHz' (MT7996 BN_6188); 0x8308f104 [27:16] = round(0x280000 / f) (notes/06).
PHY_WF0_SFO_CFO 0x8300d0ac [25:8] = round(0x1400000 / f_MHz) << s, s = 0/1/2/3 for 20/40/80/160 (80+80: 2); no narrow case (notes/06).
AGC table port 0x830000dc: 48 entries 0x80 | idx<<16 | v, v = v20 + 48*bw (table 0x02029448); enums 0, 5, 6 use the 20 MHz column (notes/06).
PHY_WFCOMM_PRIMCH 0x830a0080 [7:4] = 2.4 GHz channel index (40 MHz: +-2; other widths 6); only for 2.4 GHz channel frequencies (notes/06).
Static PHY init: TX tables 0x8308c000..c070 (+0x10000 band 1), 0x830a38xx, 0x830ad4c4..; no bandwidth terms (notes/06).
Writes 34 band registers 0x8308fc30..0x8308fcb4 (+0x10000 path 1) for 2.4 GHz (notes/06).

Writes PHY_BN_MODE 0x83081000: [27:24] PHY BW class (0/1/2/7 = 20/40/80/160, masked to 0 for narrow), [30:28] = 0x5 for enum 6 ('10 MHz') and 0x7 for enum 5 ('5 MHz'), forcing [28] even at 2.4 GHz. The hardware gives TX /4 at 0xd and /8 at 0xf: there is no /2 (notes/07). Per-path tail: A-die RF 0xb00/0xb04 converter class (not a sample-rate control). The 2022 twin is FUN_93892c.

WFSYS_TICKCR0 0x820b00a0: [1:0] WLAN_CLK_MODE, [4:2] LMAC_1X_MODE when clk < 3. A MAC/LMAC tick, not the PHY clock: 0x5 at cbw 4, 0xa at cbw 5. With the narrow divider and WLAN_CLK_MODE = 0 the transmitter never ends a PPDU (notes/03, 05).
AGG_BWCR 0x820e2004 [3:2] (GCI selector 0x20162): 0 for 20 (1 if SCO != 0), 1 for 40, 2 for 80, 3 for 160/80+80. MT7996's RATE BWCR role (notes/05).
Channel-set MAC routine (freq, ch, bw, p4, band): v = bw==4 ? 2 : bw==5 ? 1 : 0, wfsysSetTickcr0(v, v) -> TICKCR0 0xa (5 MHz) / 0x5 (10 MHz); aggSetBwClass (notes/05).
ARB_SCR 0x820e3000 fields 0/1: MAC TX/RX enables (bit 8 = TX off, bit 9 = RX off; RX must stay on or the ICAP front end freezes) (notes/03, 05).
MAC IFS init; calls ROM FUN_828848 (notes/clock tree).

TMAC 0x820e4008 [8:0] = 0xbe (2.4 GHz) / 4 (5 GHz) on every switch.

WF power sequence (0x7c005008 handshakes): mode 2 = wake (A-die RF 0xbc = 0x11, WFSYS_PWR_SEQ 0x820b00a8 [11:10] = 3), mode 3 = sleep (RF 0xbc = 1, [11:10] = 2); then RF 0x21c/0xcc4 PLL/VCO steps. Power states, not a clock-rate selection (notes/03, 07).
HAL wrapper of wfsysPowerSeq: (0, 2) on wake, (0, 3) before sleep.

ContiTx start (DBDC, CtrCh, CentCh, BW, Mask, Rate, Mode): BW 0/1/2/3 -> class 0/1/2/7; copies the TX-vector latch PHY_TXV_LATCH0.. (0x8308a830..85c, the last TX vector) into the test-signal generator PHY_SIGGEN_CFG0.. (0x8308a008..a024, a040..a04c); PHY_BN_MODE = 0x80000000 | class<<24 (narrow bits cleared); 0x8308b000 = 0x44000000, 0x8308b004 = 0x30000000, 0x830ac004 = 0x16011400, 0x8308b020 = 0x100000 when Rate has no mode bits, 0x8308b024 = 0x10 (OFDM), 0x83081044 = 0x10 then 0x30, 0x830ad4d8 = 0x101f1f10. The decompilation stops at an ifcall9 (0x9690da); the disassembly continues: 0x8300c000/0x8301c000 bit 31 cleared, 0x83080004/08 = 0x38, 0x830ac054 = 0x10, PHY_SIGGEN_START = 0x80000000. Replayed by hand (tools/guest/contitx.sh), this generator emits an unmodulated LO carrier: a calibration source, not a PPDU source (notes/07).

ContiTx stop (DBDC, Rate): PHY_SIGGEN_START = 0, 0x8300d008/0x8301d008 = 0x1d10, 0x83081044 = 0, 0x830ac004 = 0x16151400, 0x8308b000 = 0xcc000000, 0x830ad4d8 = 0, 0x8300c000 bit 31 set; the decompilation stops at an ifcall9, the disassembly continues: 0x83080004/08 = 0, 0x8308b004 = 0, PHY_RST_CTRL = 0x38048, contiTxRestoreRegs. Stop it before any rig reset (notes/07).

TX tone (TxTone): (chain, type, FREQ, ...). type 0 FREQ 0 = DC tone whose I/Q is PHY_TONE_DC_IQ 0x8308fc08 (I [11:0], Q [27:16]): a live linear IQ DAC, at most 4.2 M writes/s from the MCU (fw hk_dacplay, hk_wrspeed; notes/09, 07). Forces the band clocks (0x83080004/08 = 0xffffff).
Stops the tone generator; does NOT restore stock values (leaves 0x83080004/08 = 0, 0x8300c000 = 0x802741a0, 0x8300d008 = 0x1d00, ...). Stop before any rig reset, then reload (notes/07).
